payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_a_lens_with_an_error_still_sends_the_hosts_survivors_to_rebut_and_ends_incomplete stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/review.py. The claim was "When a lens has an `error`, REVIEW's pool cut nothing, and `review.rebuts_despite_errors(reviews, cut)` holds, the task goes to REBUT. REVIEW's line is the line `review.review_state` returned, then `, and N host-filed survivor(s) go to REBUT`. N is the count `review.host_survivors` returns over every lens. REBUT takes every blocker `review.anchored_blockers` returns, as it does today. `run_rebut` gets each lens with an `error` in `unreviewed`, so such a lens gets no verdict session. Each other lens holding a blocker gets its own. When REBUT ends `READY_FOR_REVIEW` or `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED`, the task ends `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE`, and so does its ledger row. Its REBUT line and `rebuttal.json`'s `state` and `why` carry that state and `review.incomplete_after_rebut(reviews, entries)`. `entries` is the list `_rebut_gates` wrote to `rebut-probes.json`, or empty when it wrote none. The witness drives four cells. In one, adequacy's output is not the schema twice. In one, adequacy's session fails. In both, adequacy holds both survivors. In the third, correctness's and conventions's sessions fail and adequacy's output is not the schema twice. Adequacy sits between the other two in `review.LENSES`. The line names all three lenses, and none gets a verdict session. In the fourth, correctness's session fails, contract files a blocker of its own, and adequacy holds both survivors with no `error`. REBUT ends `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no verdict in the first and third, `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` on a fix claimed and not committed in the second, and `READY_FOR_REVIEW` on two lenses' verdicts in the fourth. The two survivors are of a criterion's own edit and of the spec's own wrong version. Their fates are killed, survived, and not asked again because HEAD did not move.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_review.py::test_a_wrong_versions_survivor_names_the_version_it_came_from, tests/test_session.py::test_every_probe_a_session_names_is_applied_under_its_own_criterion_and_each_survivor_blocks, tests/test_session.py::test_a_survivor_the_whole_suite_kills_stays_a_blocker_naming_the_killing_tests, tests/test_session.py::test_a_survivor_the_whole_suite_also_misses_says_the_suite_stayed_green, tests/test_session.py::test_a_survivor_whose_whole_suite_cannot_answer_keeps_todays_blocker, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
